passage.title: Teacher's model report, written for TGA
paras: Clouds are made of tiny drops of water. Some clouds are white and fluffy. Grey clouds can bring rain.
Rain falls from clouds. Plants and animals need rain to live.
The sun gives us light and heat. Never look straight at the sun.

questions.model: I do: the title is at the top, in big letters: Our Sky.

questions.q: What does the sun give us?
write two facts from the report
questions.a: For example: Grey clouds can bring rain. The sun gives us light.
questions.model: I do first: I look under Clouds. Fact: Clouds are made of tiny drops of water.

questions.q: write a new fact for one heading
questions.a: For example: The sun is a star.
